metadata.Name: x-stance
metadata.Description: A large-scale, multilingual, multi-target stance detection dataset extracted from comments written by candidates of elections in Switzerland. It consists of German, French and Italian text, containing over 67,000 comments on more than 150 political issues.
metadata.Paper Title: x-stance: A Multilingual Multi-Target Dataset for Stance Detection
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 5th SwissText & 16th KONVENS Joint Conference 2020
Affiliations: Department of Computational Linguistics, University of Zurich
School of Informatics, University of Edinburgh
metadata.Abstract: We extract a large-scale stance detection data-set from comments written by candidates of elections in Switzerland. The dataset consists of German, French and Italian text, allowing for a cross-lingual evaluation of stance detection. It contains 67,000 comments on more than 150 political issues (targets). Unlike stance detection models that have specific target issues, we use the dataset to train a single model on all the issues. To make learning across targets possible, we prepend to each instance a natural question that represents the target (e.g. 'Do you support X?'). Baseline results from multilingual BERT show that zero-shot cross-lingual and cross-target transfer of stance detection is moderately successful with this approach.
